og_51_2011.title: Закон за изменување на Законот за кривичната постапка

sunset_clause.rule: The provisions of the 51/2011 amending act cease when the Criminal Procedure Act 150/2010 begins application.

og_100_2012.title: Закон за изменување и дополнување на Законот за кривичната постапка
key_effects: Articles 566 and 567 were amended to include 51/2011 in the predecessor-law citation chain.
Article 568 was amended so the 150/2010 Act begins application on 2013-12-01.

timing.transition_caveat: Proceedings begun before application of the 150/2010 Act remain governed by the predecessor regime to the extent provided by Articles 566-567.

citation_variance.note: Some later official decisions list 51/2011 alongside 150/2010 when citing the Criminal Procedure Act. The operative text of OG 51/2011 itself targets the 15/1997 predecessor chain, while OG 100/2012 expressly places 51/2011 into Articles 566-567 as predecessor-law transition history. Classification follows the operative official acts rather than citation shorthand.
